reference.reason: Absolute strategy robustness is insufficient; the replacement decision depends on robustness of the matched daily improvement over the existing control.

audits: uplift after removing the 5, 10 and 20 largest positive uplift days
uplift by all 13 months and four chronological blocks
share of positive uplift from the 5, 10 and 20 largest uplift days
random binary style-split null preserving ensemble order

requirements: top-20 positive-uplift days removed mean remains positive
at least 8 of 13 monthly uplifts are positive
all four chronological blocks have nonnegative uplift
ordinary moving-block one-sided 90 percent lower uplift exceeds zero
expected shortfall 5 percent is no worse than control
fixed_support_rule.interpretation: Failure means the mechanism is not a robust replacement. It may remain a labelled forward research arm, but not the primary shadow specification.

random_null.definition: Keep the ensemble leader. Assign subsequent ensemble-ordered candidates independently to the opposite pseudo-style group with probability 0.5 and take the first opposite candidate, which is the null analogue of an arbitrary binary style split.
